description: Adopt a new ERP module (SAP S/4HANA AR — Accounts Receivable) for an enterprise currently using a legacy billing system. The adoption must follow: module configuration (configure SAP AR: company code, credit control area, customer master data, payment terms), data migration (migrate customer master data and open AR items from the legacy system — 100K customers, 500K open items), parallel-run period (run both the legacy system and SAP AR for one billing cycle — compare invoice generation, payment posting, dunning), finance/close reconciliation (verify that the trial balance AR account reconciles between the legacy system and SAP AR at period close — this is a hard gate: cutover cannot proceed if reconciliation fails), and cutover (switch to SAP AR as primary, decommission legacy billing). A rollback plan must exist (revert to legacy billing for new transactions, SAP AR becomes read-only). Risk factors: the finance/close window is a hard scheduling constraint (cutover can only happen after a close period — not mid-period), customer master data mapping errors, and open-item reconciliation discrepancies. Tools available: SAP S/4HANA, SAP Data Services (migration), Excel (reconciliation), SQL, SAP Fiori (configuration UI).
